ig_caption:
You are the one who starts every conversation, and nobody notices.
You are not needy for wanting the same back. You are the warm room, and even a warm room needs a fire lit for it.
Today, ask one person for one small thing and let them carry it.
Comment HELD if you are always the one who reaches out first, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
